row:
Takurua Vets is a modern companion animal veterinary clinic based in Christchurch, New Zealand.

Our team provides personalised veterinary care for dogs and cats, including routine health services, emergency after-hours care, and our purpose-built boarding cattery.

This channel shares practical, vet-led video guides on animal health, behaviour, anxiety reduction, and what to expect when visiting the clinic - designed to help pet owners feel informed and confident about their pet’s care.
